note: Change history for Genome v1, linking each change to the requirements it touches. Commits and pull requests hold the detail. There is no release yet, so every change has release: null.

changes.summary: Genome v1 draft: gene registry and panels, per-gene snapshot capture with SHA-256 manifests, VCF header gate (GRCh38, VCF 4.2–4.5), licence inventory with a commercial-pilot safeguard.

Source governance: per-action source policy enforced in capture, display copy, loader, screens and export; raw responses moved out of public/; ClinVar withheld and its captured files removed (recorded in REDACTIONS.json); clinical release gate; governance records; status panel; registry-driven target.
